title: Awesome Revit Plugins
description: A curated list of plugins, add-ins, extensions, and developer tools for Autodesk Revit, split into open-source and paid.
intro: Awesome Revit Plugins is a curated list of free and commercial add-ins, plugins, and developer tools for Autodesk Revit, for BIM and AEC teams and developers.
